extraction_notes: Fig. 3 SS25-SS26 curve and Fig. 4 SS22-SS26 solid curves were sampled directly from the supplied vector plots; no intermediate points were synthesized. Reverse-current values are represented as positive magnitudes in the plotted mA axis.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF=0.70 V at IF=2.0 A for the SS25-SS26 group; maximum IR1=0.5 mA at VR=VDC=60 V and Ta=25 degC for the SS22-SS26 group; separate maximum IR2=50 mA at VR=VDC=60 V and Ta=100 degC; and typical CJ=500 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz for the SS22-SS26 group. IR2 is not used as the reverse-current fit target.

Absolute-rating bounds for SS26 are VRRM=60 V, VRMS=42 V, VDC=60 V, IF(AV)=2.0 A, and IFSM=50 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave, Ta=25 degC; junction and storage temperature ranges are -55 to +150 degC. These are limits, not fitted curve points.

The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC ratings are not treated as breakdown data. Fig. 1 derating and Fig. 2 surge-current plots are rating curves and are omitted from the compact DC curve set.
